title: M33.0–M33.2 Universal Creative Studio: capability truth, brand kit, universal planner (+ type-contract fix)
head: feat/m33-universal-creative-studio
body:
## M33 milestone report (Guide §12 format)

**North star:** `docs/GIFTZ_UNIVERSAL_CREATIVE_STUDIO_GUIDE.md` (added to the repo in M33.0 at its documented home).

### 1. Baseline

- Repository `Ebin0471/BEAN-Folio`, branch `main`, published baseline `74123a5` (PR #7 merge — re-fetched and verified before work).
- Worktree clean; no user work discarded. Local lineage reconciliation commits (`f2f3ecd`, `84b6af1`) deliberately restore the published lineage as ancestors; duplicated local-only work (`f24e8af`, `3aa6a57`) is preserved with both parent histories intact.

### 2. What this PR contains

**M33.0 — Architecture and capability truth (no new dependencies)**
- `docs/GIFTZ_UNIVERSAL_CREATIVE_STUDIO_GUIDE.md` added to the repository; linked from the README index.
- `docs/UNIVERSAL_STUDIO_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md` — source-backed capability/gap matrix for GIFTZ / LAXII / RIISHE with status labels `existing / partial / removed / owner-setup-required / backend-required / unsupported`, registry counts derived from **live imports**, route-tree counts, and a licence/model/font provenance decision register (§5 of the matrix).
- Machine-checked honesty: `tests/universal-studio-capability-matrix.test.ts` pins every documented count to the imported registry, every cited evidence path to disk, the RIISHE no-`giftz.*`/`laxii.*`-tools claim to the live registry, and the canonical 2048×687 banner preset. If code and doc drift apart, the test fails.
- Stale claims fixed at their sources: `section.add` model-facing description now generated from `SECTION_TYPES` itself (`featured`/`reel` were omitted), stale section-type comments in `playbooks.ts` / `site-export.ts` corrected, `docs/laxii/README.md` carries a HISTORICAL banner for the removed preserve-pixel engine.

**M33.1 — Brand intelligence and font pairing**
- `src/lib/brand-kit.ts` — deterministic brand-attribute → validated brand-kit proposal engine shared by GIFTZ and LAXII. Strict zod input (psychometric inference fields rejected outright), 2–3 font pairings scored over the live 129-family `SITE_FONTS` registry with real-weights-only guarantee, unknown font/palette ids REJECTED with same-kind suggestions (never silent substitution), user font override respected exactly, non-Latin language requests marked `glyphCoverage: "unverified"` with honest notes (the registry carries no per-family glyph metadata), palette candidates gated by real body-contrast checks (≥ 4.5), motion personality mapped to registry-valid presets, deterministic output.
- `POST /api/giftz/brand-kit` — owner-scoped (401 unauthenticated), rate-limited (30/min), no persistence, no model call. Applying a proposal stays an explicit user action through existing save flows.

**M33.2 — Universal website planner and capability router**
- `src/lib/giftz/site-taxonomy.ts` — 21-family website taxonomy (Guide §3) with per-feature honest capability tiers (`static-ready / owner-setup-required / backend-required / unsupported`; registry self-validation forbids any `connected-ready` claim and requires honest notes on non-static tiers).
- `src/lib/giftz/site-planner.ts` — deterministic family classification (high/medium/low confidence + alternates; ambiguous briefs never guess), sitemap/section plans only from live `SECTION_TYPES`, feature matrix distinguishing user-requested rows from family disclosure, content-gap list, prompt-injection-resistant routing (brief text is untrusted data; a `backend-required` classification can never be argued into config/file mode), explicit `architectureRequest` instead of dead buttons.
- `POST /api/giftz/planner` — owner-scoped, read-only.

**Type-contract fix (`a2e96a8`)**
- `buildBrandKitProposal` was typed with the zod OUTPUT type (4 defaulted fields required) while its body normalizes those fields with `??` fallbacks — direct partial-input calls compiled at runtime but produced 12 `TS2345` errors under `bunx tsc --noEmit`. Parameter is now the schema INPUT shape (`BrandKitRawInput = z.input<typeof schema>`); runtime behavior unchanged. **`bunx tsc --noEmit`: 0 errors** (was 12).

### 3. Tests executed (actual results)

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `bun test` — 3 new M33 suites (capability-matrix, brand-kit, planner) | **46 pass / 0 fail** |
| Full QA suite, isolated QA worktree + pinned QA DB (`qa-db-env.sh assert`), HEAD `78f04d2` | 1729 pass / 13 skip / **13 fail** |
| Full QA suite, same environment, **untouched baseline `74123a5`** (2 runs) | 8 fail / 8 fail — same failure classes |
| Failure classification | Every failing suite **passes in isolation** at HEAD (verified: shared-cache 12/12, riishe-persona-contract 13/13, riishe-specialists 19/19, tenant-host-routing 33/33, giftz-filegen-budget 8/8); failure **sets vary run-to-run at both baseline and HEAD** → pre-existing parallel-contention interference of DB-bound suites on a single SQLite file, **not** an M33 regression |
| `bunx tsc --noEmit` | **0 errors** (12 before the type-contract fix) |
| `bun run lint` | **0 errors**, 14 warnings (all pre-existing, unrelated files) |
| Schema parity (`scripts/check-schema-parity.ts`) | **104 models identical** sqlite ↔ postgres mirror |
| `prisma validate` × 2 (sqlite; postgres with placeholder URL) | both **valid** |
| `bun run build` (Next production build, QA worktree) | **exit 0** |
| Dev server (`ensure-dev.sh`) | healthy; `POST /api/media/upload` → 401 guarded |
| Runtime-data + secret scans (bean-sync) | clean |

### 4. Browser evidence

- Landing 1440px + 390px: renders cleanly, **no console errors**, no horizontal overflow, sticky footer correct (`agent-ctx/shots/m33/pub-01-landing-1440.png`, `pub-03-landing-390.png`).
- GIFTZ surface (`/#/giftz`) anonymous: privacy gate holds — "Sign in to continue"; owner-scoped APIs not reachable (`pub-02-giftz-1440.png`). Authenticated studio views were browser-verified on an isolated QA DB (committed evidence: `agent-ctx/shots/m33/01–04-*.png`).

### 5. Security / licence / data

- No new third-party dependency (licence register unchanged; GrapesJS pin untouched).
- Prompt-injection resistance tested in the planner suite; strict-schema rejection of psychometric fields tested in the brand-kit suite.
- Owner-scoped endpoints: 401 without session; rate-limited; no persistence.
- **No production DDL, no `db push` against any live DB, no deploy, no DNS/domain, no paid provisioning.** QA ran only against the isolated worktree DB (`scripts/ops/qa-db-env.sh` assert-validated).

### 6. Known limitations (honest)

- RIISHE has **no** registered `giftz.*` / `laxii.*` tools today (M35 scope; the capability matrix pins this claim).
- LAXII preserve-pixel identity-locked avatars are **removed** (historic engine); any UI claiming it is stale — matrix documents this truthfully.
- Full-suite parallel runs exhibit pre-existing flaky interference on DB-bound suites (failure sets vary per run at baseline and HEAD); suites pass in isolation.
- Banner preset registry is still the single canonical 2048×687 preset (M33.4 scope).

### 7. Next milestone

**M33.3 — GIFTZ quality gate**: consolidate accessibility/SEO/internal-link/responsive checks into one report with evidence and explicit untested areas; real-browser QA at 390/768/1024/1440; proposal approval/rollback/versioning unchanged.

🟢 Owner review requested — **do not merge without review**. Publication of `main` accompanies this PR via the verified `scripts/ops/bean-sync.sh` fast-forward flow (SHA-verified in the milestone report).
